camp.cannot_start: cannot start a campaign with status “{status}”
camp.choose_column: choose the column containing the phone numbers
camp.csv_shape: the file must contain a header row followed by at least one data row
camp.is_batch: this campaign is handled by OVH (batch)
cli.account_short: Saved OVH accounts (add and edit them in the application)
cli.account_use_short: Changes the active account (shared with the application)
cli.camp_long:
SMS campaigns from a CSV file.

Two modes:
  batch  same message for everyone, processed by OVH (continues if you close the terminal);
  local  one SMS per recipient ({column} variables), limited rate, run by this process:
         Ctrl-C pauses the campaign, “smsh campaign resume <id>” resumes it.
cli.camp_short: SMS campaigns from a CSV file
cli.cancel_short: Cancels a campaign (scheduled batch: cancelled at OVH)
cli.col_not_detected: phone number column not detected: specify --phone-col (headers: {headers})
cli.confirm_required: confirmation required: add --yes to continue without an interactive terminal
cli.crm_confirm: Delete this campaign from the local history?
cli.crm_short: Deletes a campaign from the local history (nothing is deleted at OVH)
cli.fl_file: read the message from a file (“-”: standard input)
cli.fl_match: delete all SMS matching the filters
cli.fl_mode: batch | local (default: batch, or local if the template has variables)
cli.fl_phone_col: phone number column: header name or position (1 = first); detected by default
cli.fl_template_file: read the template from a file (“-”: standard input)
cli.fl_wait: batch mode: wait for the send to finish
cli.follow_interrupted: interrupted: campaign paused, resume with “smsh campaign resume {id}”
cli.ls_short: Lists the SMS sent (local cache, most recent first)
cli.resume_local_only: only local-mode campaigns can be resumed
cli.resume_short: Resumes a paused local campaign (run in this terminal)
cli.retry_short: Retries the failed recipients of a local campaign
cli.rm_dry: Dry run: {count} SMS would be deleted.
cli.rm_need: give either identifiers, or --match with filters
cli.rm_short: Deletes SMS from the history at OVH and in the local cache
cli.root_long:
Smsh on the command line. Uses the same accounts, key vault
and local database as the graphical application (set up the account in the application).

Passphrase-protected vault: set SMSH_PASSPHRASE or type it when asked.
Language: SMSH_LANG variable (fr or en), otherwise the system language.
Exit codes: 0 success, 1 error, 2 usage error.
cli.root_short: Smsh: send and track OVH SMS from the command line
cli.run_created: Campaign “{name}” created (OVH batch {batch}). Follow it with: smsh campaign show {id}
cli.run_example:
smsh campaign run contacts.csv -m "Hello {first_name}, see you tomorrow." --dry-run
  smsh campaign run contacts.csv -f message.txt --name "Reminder" --phone-col phone --yes
  smsh campaign run list.csv -m "Sale -20%" --mode batch --at "2026-11-10 09:00" --stop --yes
cli.run_need_file: give the CSV file: smsh campaign run <file.csv> -m "message"
cli.send_example:
smsh send +33612345678 -m "Hello"
  smsh send +33612345678 +14155552671 -f message.txt --yes
  echo "Reminder" | smsh send +33612345678 -f - --at "2026-11-06 09:00" --yes
cli.send_short: Sends an SMS to 5 numbers at most (use “campaign run” for more)
cli.show_short: Details of a campaign (--recipients: list the recipients)
cli.status_short: Tests the connection and shows the balance and senders of the active account
cli.sync_done: {listed} SMS known to OVH over {days} days, {fetched} downloaded, {removed} removed from the cache, {remaining} remaining.
cli.sync_short: Updates the local history cache from OVH
